deep_dive.title: SymbolicLight V2: Hybrid Neuromorphic Architecture and Sparse Execution for Low-Energy Language Inference
deep_dive.abstract: SymbolicLight V2 combines sparse event computation with continuous-state processing in a hybrid neuromorphic language architecture. Extending V1's spike-gated dual paths, it adds graded signed events at further projections and softmax-free local attention. We implement the 194M-parameter model on an Alveo U50C FPGA using digital fixed-point arithmetic and on an ARM CPU using sparse integer execution. Across three same-checkpoint FPGA implementations at 175 MHz, active-row weight gathering and valid-state KV loading raise decode throughput from 474.6 to 643.2 tokens/s for a 32-token prefix and 128 outputs. Estimated gross card energy falls from 0.06087 to 0.04407 J per generated token, a 27.6% reduction. Complete-request energy, including prefill, falls by 24.4-27.7% across three prefix lengths. An independent idle split attributes 82.8% of gross card energy to loaded idle, explaining the benefit of shorter token latency. Against the recorded RTX 5090 compiled-FP32 baseline, integer FPGA execution uses 89.1% less estimated card energy during short-context decode; arithmetic precisions differ, and the GPU baseline is not the lowest-energy tested configuration. On four Cortex-A76 cores of a ROCK 5T, complete requests reach 65.4 tokens/s at 9.80 W and 0.151 J per generated token at the adapter's AC input. These results connect event sparsity to omitted computation and data movement. The mechanisms also support other dedicated V2 implementations: increasing throughput by a greater factor than active power lowers energy per generated token. Evaluation holds the deployed checkpoint fixed; its quality trails a same-budget dense control, so the results do not establish equal-quality efficiency.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: SymbolicLight V2 combines sparse event computation with continuous-state processing in a hybrid neuromorphic language architecture, implemented on FPGA and ARM CPU to raise decode throughput and cut energy per token by 27.6%.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 面向低能耗语言推理，本文提出SymbolicLight V2混合神经形态架构，将稀疏事件计算与连续状态处理结合，在V1脉冲门控双路径基础上加入带符号分级事件与无softmax局部注意力。作者将194M参数模型分别用定点算术实现在Alveo U50C FPGA上、用稀疏整数执行实现在ARM CPU上。三种同检查点FPGA实现（175MHz）通过活跃行权重收集与有效状态KV加载，将解码吞吐从474.6提升至643.2 tokens/s，每生成token能耗下降27.6%。该工作展示了软硬协同的稀疏低能耗语言推理路径。
